title: VersionShift replication package: do library upgrades change machine-learning conclusions?
description: Code, frozen protocol, fold-level results and post-review evidence for the study 'When a Library Upgrade Changes the Verdict: Default-Configuration Drift and the Stability of Machine-Learning Comparisons' (submitted to Information and Software Technology). Six scikit-learn classifiers on 63 OpenML-CC18 tasks with frozen folds, across 0.21.3 to 0.22.2.post1 and 1.8.0 to 1.9.1. The release asset VersionShift_replication.zip (SHA-256 5eb716b64c21ded6f979b0b1610bb68aee46ad2f24889a0d3b133bd430c6ff7d) is the frozen original-study archive required by the post-review kits.

creators.name: Yavanoğlu, Uraz
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Engineering, Gazi University, Ankara, Türkiye

notes: Financially supported by UAYTECH Corporation. OpenML-CC18 datasets are not redistributed; they are rebuilt from OpenML and checked against frozen SHA-256 hashes.
